quiz.prompt: Which quantity never decreases in an isolated system?
quiz.explanation: The second law says the entropy of an isolated system never decreases.

quiz.prompt: An isolated system exchanges energy but not matter with its surroundings.
quiz.explanation: An isolated system exchanges neither matter nor energy.

quiz.prompt: In which unit must temperatures be given for the Carnot formula?
quiz.explanation: The formula uses absolute temperatures, so kelvin.

quiz.prompt: Why can no heat engine be 100% efficient?
options: Some heat must be rejected to the cold reservoir
Hot reservoirs are never hot enough
quiz.explanation: The second law requires some heat to be rejected to the cold reservoir.

quiz.prompt: If A and B are each in thermal equilibrium with C, what follows?
options: A and B are in thermal equilibrium with each other
A and B have equal mass
Heat flows from A to B
A and B have no temperature
quiz.explanation: That is the zeroth law of thermodynamics.

quiz.prompt: Energy can be created from nothing.
quiz.explanation: The first law says energy is only transferred or converted.

quiz.prompt: What happens to the entropy of a perfect crystal as temperature approaches absolute zero?
quiz.explanation: The third law says it approaches zero.

quiz.prompt: Two systems in thermal equilibrium have the same ____.

quiz.explanation: Entropy is a measure of disorder.

quiz.prompt: A heat engine turns heat into work by moving heat from a hot reservoir to a cold one.
quiz.explanation: That is how a heat engine works.
It is one minus the cold temperature divided by the hot temperature, in kelvin.

bullets: Zeroth law: equal temperature means thermal equilibrium.
First law: energy is conserved, only transferred or converted.
Second law: entropy of an isolated system never decreases.
Third law: entropy of a perfect crystal tends to zero at absolute zero.
Entropy measures the disorder of a system.
A heat engine turns heat into work between a hot and a cold reservoir.
No engine is 100% efficient because some heat is always rejected.
Carnot efficiency is 1 minus Tc over Th, in kelvin.

key_terms.meaning: A measure of the disorder of a system.
Turns heat into work between two reservoirs.
Maximum efficiency, 1 minus Tc over Th.
